priority_dimensions.why: Extremely tight 4-week timeline to get historical OHLCV and corporate actions working in staging before wealth manager onboarding.
Requires navigating strict SEBI compliance, exchange data authorization (NSE/BSE), and handling sensitive client portfolios.
Corporate actions (splits, mergers, dividends) require constant manual oversight and adjustment, leading to significant long-term maintenance bloat.
Evaluating the high cost of dedicating a 5-engineer team to build raw market data pipelines instead of core portfolio analytics.
Need to assess the complexity of integrating ClickHouse, DuckDB, or the market-data-warehouse pattern into their existing AWS EKS, Kafka, and TimescaleDB stack.
